entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste Annibal Aubert du Bayet was a French Army officer, politician and diplomat active during the French Revolution. Born in Baton Rouge, Louisiana in 1759, he fought in the American Revolutionary War and the French Revolutionary Wars.
